title: Podgorica recovery run
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 50min at 135-145bpm, cadence 170+ (no shuffling), no pick-ups.
GYM: none.
FUEL: none.
STOP RULE: KNEE GATE first: 10 single-leg squats left + 2 flights of stairs down. Any left-knee pain, or HRV under 60, or calves/quads still sore from Monza: swap for 50min hotel bike at 120-135bpm. Pain during the run: stop and walk back.
WHY: day 2 after the half, flush only; quality moved out of this week.
